personal.name: Felipe Silva
personal.competencies:
Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience delivering high-complexity systems and distributed processing at global industry leaders — including an 8-year tenure at Capgemini and 6+ years as a consultant at Avenue Code, currently driving engineering excellence for eBay.

Proven expertise in mission-critical, high-availability systems, transforming massive data volumes into resilient business solutions. Solid background in architectural best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-driven development.

Fluent in English, actively improving French (B2 Certificate — YMCA International Language School). Currently based in Montreal.

band.name: Band on the Run
band.description: Beyond engineering, music has always been a creative outlet. Playing and recording keeps me grounded and brings a different kind of problem-solving outside the screen.

sideProjects.name: SMS Based Residential Security
sideProjects.description: A residential alarm system prototype that uses SMS messaging for real-time alerts and remote control, built with low-cost hardware integration.

experiences.role: Senior Software Engineer — Consultant for eBay
experiences.description: 6-year continuous engagement at eBay (Tier-1 client). Leading architectural decisions for SEO and process planning ecosystems. Architected mission-critical canonical URL infrastructure and distributed systems processing massive data volumes for millions of products globally. Integrated AI-driven workflows and LLMs to accelerate engineering productivity. Responsible for technical interviews and talent pipeline optimization.

Designed and developed JavaFX desktop solutions and REST APIs (Jersey) with automated update agents. Implemented cloud-based monitoring via Firebase Functions and engineered Python-based IoT integrations for RFID and SmartCard (HID) systems.
Development of enterprise applications for the Brazilian Health Ministry using Java, Swing, EJB, Oracle DB, and Spring.
Development of management applications for Oi Telecom using Java, C#, PHP, C++, Delphi, and Richfaces.
